references.text: The introduction to the chapter where Moses is instructed to speak to the children of Israel about the Lord's feasts, which form the framework for the entire chapter 23.
A previous overview of the three annual feasts that the men of Israel were to celebrate before the Lord.
A parallel conclusion in Numbers that also summarizes the feasts and sacrifices that Moses proclaimed to the children of Israel.
Moses repeats the regulations concerning the great feasts for the children of Israel in Deuteronomy.
The verse that introduces the list of the Lord's appointed times (מֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה) which are to be observed at their set times.
